messages.subject: lightning talks in GSoC summit
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

what is the status of R lightning talks in GSoC summit?

If there is a spot available I would be glad to give a talk on the project
I was mentoring this summer named "Efficient R tools for geometrical statistics <https://summerofcode.withgoogle.com/projects/#5312431463596032>".

Best,
Vissarion Fisikopoulos.

ps. I am attending the summit with Boost C++ libraries since I was also a mentor with them
